purpose: Close the pre-KiCad physical architecture around direct i8080-8, a fully counted 80-contact M1, mechanically unloaded board retention, direct 5+5 antenna locality, local nRF concurrency and a one-signal FPV interboard path.

policy.coordinates: world X/Y from the accepted assembly-coordinate model; RF-inner drawing is mirrored only for the viewer
policy.base_geometry: R1 bodies are retained only as a collision-tested placement seed and may move during complete R2 optimisation
policy.fixed_body: one exact serial device per rectangle
policy.reserve: a dashed physical allocation, never a component or accepted MPN
policy.silkscreen: none of the inner-face annotations in the generated engineering drawing are PCB silkscreen; every outer-face label must pass a generated no-overlap audit against component bodies, installed cables, mounting keep-outs and covered accessory zones
policy.antenna_identification: Every outward RF port keeps a readable role/band label and gains a compact kit code. A post-assembly colour collar around the connector base and a durable heat-shrink flag on the matching antenna repeat that code; colour is redundant and is never the sole identifier.

antenna_bank_optimization.installation_sequence: five rear SMA ports retain an even pitch; the lower FPV MMCX uses a right-angle plug whose cable exits along -X below the SMA bodies and away from both mounting holes, while the temporary finger-approach envelope is verified ergonomically in H5
antenna_bank_optimization.reason: move complete radio/control/evidence islands so every main antenna terminates on its source PCB; no high-speed radio bus and no main RF trace crosses M1

antenna_silkscreen.role: short user-facing PCB silk sits in the free strip below the physical RF bodies and installed FPV cable; the adjacent documentation legend expands every code

m1.video_crossing: one 75-ohm FPV_CVBS signal beside ground; decoder and 11-line camera RX bus remain UI-local
m1.nrf_evidence: three active-low evidence lines remain explicit safety crossings; only their direction reverses

functional_partition.transport: rear audio at 48-kHz full duplex remains below 0.4 MB/s on the 1.5-MB/s qualified RP link; nRF payload is now front-local

mechanical_retention.m1_rule: M1 is never a load-bearing member
mechanical_retention.pcb_capture: independent front and rear enclosure lips/edge rails prevent board separation and relative shear even with any one screw loosened by one turn
mechanical_retention.fasteners: captive or thread-locked M2.5 screws with a documented torque; parallel mating fixture required
mechanical_retention.h5_proof: continuity and solder-joint inspection after one-loose-screw handling, drop, vibration and 50 service mating cycles

battery_holder_mechanics.drawing_rule: render the 77.06-mm plastic body separately from the 86.00-mm PCB pad span
battery_holder_mechanics.load_path: an enclosure cradle and two end stops capture the plastic body and cell insertion axis so insertion, removal and drop loads do not peel the SMT pads
battery_holder_mechanics.h5_proof: cell insertion/removal cycles and drop inspection with the enclosure load path installed
